This '''city''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eiattu 6]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] sat on one of the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and contained the [[Imperial Citadel (Eiattu 6)|citadel]] of Eiattu's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]].
